title: Underscore in the cap flag value

request.goal: The broker is started with the arguments --max-cumulative-usd 1_000 . Using only the source and Python's own float() semantics, is the value rejected by argparse, or which float is stored?

code.title: scripts/native_transition_broker.py excerpt

pass: It is accepted: float('1_000') is 1000.0 because Python allows underscores between digits, and 1000.0 is finite and positive, so the cap is 1000.0 USD.
fail: argparse rejects it: 1_000 is not a valid float.
It is stored as 1.0: the underscore ends the number, and 1000 would need no underscore.
It is rejected with "max-cumulative-usd must be a positive finite number".
